subject: english
question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

The univarsity claims students can face a law-suit or fine for violating the UNO smoking prohibition.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **univarsity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"univarsity"** is incorrectly spelt and should be **"university".** (विश्वविद्यालय)
 
• **"University"** refers to an institution of higher education and research which grants academic degrees in various subjects. (विश्वविद्यालय)
 
 
• **Example: **The university offers a variety of programs in science, arts, and commerce.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "university".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Violating** (उल्लंघन करना): Breaking or failing to comply with a rule or formal agreement.

 
 
• **Example:** He was fined for violating traffic rules.
 
 
 
• **Prohibition** (निषेध): The action of forbidding something, especially by law.
 
 
• **Example:** The prohibition of alcohol was enforced during the 1920s in the United States.
 
 
 
• **Claims** (दावा करना): Assert that something is the case, typically without providing evidence or proof.
 
 
• **Example:** She claims to have seen a UFO last night.
